data.title: Bitcoin Is Up 7.1% and Solana 5.3% This Month. Ethereum Is Down 0.7% and XRP 1.4%. What Separates Them?
data.description: Four major cryptocurrencies split into two camps this month, but the weekly numbers tell a completely different story and reveal which of the apparent winners may be living on borrowed time.
